package pangolin // import "github.com/cymondez/pangolin-framework"

Package pangolin documents the panGOlin modular application framework.

The repository is establishing its M0 engineering foundation. Runtime,
persistence and security contracts are specified in design/ and are not yet
implemented. Development tools do not constitute framework conformance.

package uow // import "github.com/cymondez/pangolin-framework/persistence/uow"

Package uow defines callback-managed units of work and immutable operation
views.

VARIABLES

var (
	ErrOptionsInvalid      = errors.New("UOW_OPTIONS_INVALID")
	ErrOptionsConflict     = errors.New("UOW_OPTIONS_CONFLICT")
	ErrRequired            = errors.New("UOW_REQUIRED")
	ErrReadOnly            = errors.New("UOW_READ_ONLY")
	ErrTransactionRequired = errors.New("UOW_TRANSACTION_REQUIRED")
	ErrTenantMismatch      = errors.New("UOW_TENANT_MISMATCH")
	ErrIdentityMismatch    = errors.New("UOW_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
	ErrScopeMismatch       = errors.New("UOW_SCOPE_MISMATCH")
	ErrResourceMismatch    = errors.New("UOW_RESOURCE_MISMATCH")
	ErrClosed              = errors.New("UOW_CLOSED")
	ErrSuspended           = errors.New("UOW_SUSPENDED")
	ErrBusy                = errors.New("UOW_BUSY")
	ErrDepthExceeded       = errors.New("UOW_DEPTH_EXCEEDED")
	ErrRollbackOnly        = errors.New("UOW_ROLLBACK_ONLY")
	ErrCommitUnknown       = errors.New("UOW_COMMIT_UNKNOWN")
)

FUNCTIONS

func Check(ctx context.Context, write bool) error
    Check validates lifecycle, immutable identity, deadline and access
    restrictions.

func CheckResource(ctx context.Context, key string, write bool) error
    CheckResource refuses a second database identity without a pool fallback.

func Fail(ctx context.Context, cause error) error
    Fail preserves an adapter error and marks the active root rollback-only.

func NewManager(resource Resource, defaults DefaultOptions) (UnitOfWorkManager, error)
    NewManager validates mandatory limits before any operation can start.


TYPES

type AccessMode uint8

const (
	AccessDefault AccessMode = iota
	ReadOnly
	ReadWrite
)
type Completion struct {
	ScopeID     string
	OperationID string
	Outcome     Outcome
	Err         error
}

type DefaultOptions struct {
	DefaultTimeout      time.Duration
	CleanupTimeout      time.Duration
	HookTimeout         time.Duration
	MaxRequiresNewDepth int
}

type EffectiveOptions struct {
	Mode              AccessMode
	Transactional     bool
	Isolation         Isolation
	Deadline          time.Time
	DatabaseKey       string
	ResourceScopeKind string
	ResourceScopeID   string
}

type Error interface {
	error
	Code() string
	ScopeID() string
	OperationID() string
	Outcome() Outcome
	Unwrap() error
}
    Error is the errors.As view of a UOW failure; causes remain traversable.

type Isolation uint8

const (
	IsolationDefault Isolation = iota
	ReadCommitted
	RepeatableRead
	Serializable
)
type Options struct {
	Mode        AccessMode
	Transaction TransactionMode
	Propagation Propagation
	Isolation   Isolation
	Timeout     time.Duration
}

type Outcome uint8

const (
	NotStarted Outcome = iota
	Committed
	CompletedNonTransactional
	RolledBack
	Unknown
)
type Propagation uint8

const (
	Required Propagation = iota
	RequiresNew
)
type Resource interface {
	Begin(context.Context, EffectiveOptions) (context.Context, Transaction, error)
}
    Resource installs its private executor in the callback context. Optional
    DatabaseKey and RequiresTransaction methods declare resource capabilities.

type Scope interface {
	ID() string
	Options() EffectiveOptions
	SaveChanges(context.Context) error
	SetRollbackOnly(error) error
	OnCompleted(func(context.Context, Completion) error) error
	OnFailed(func(context.Context, Completion) error) error
	OnDisposed(func(context.Context, Completion) error) error
}

type Transaction interface {
	Commit(context.Context) error
	Rollback(context.Context) error
}
    Transaction is owned exclusively by Manager, never exposed to application
    code.

type TransactionMode uint8

const (
	TransactionAuto TransactionMode = iota
	Transactional
	NonTransactional
)
type UnitOfWorkManager interface {
	Within(context.Context, Options, func(context.Context) error) error
	Current(context.Context) (Scope, bool)
}

package http // import "github.com/cymondez/pangolin-framework/transport/http"

Package http provides transaction-aware non-streaming responses and short
streaming operations. Authentication and scope binding precede these adapters.

FUNCTIONS

func Command(m uow.UnitOfWorkManager, work func(context.Context) (any, error)) http.Handler
    Command owns a top-level write boundary. A surrounding UOW is rejected so a
    joined Required callback cannot accidentally send success before its root
    commits.

func StreamOperation(ctx context.Context, m uow.UnitOfWorkManager, work func(context.Context) error) error
    StreamOperation runs one independent short query. Invoke it separately
    for each SSE/WebSocket operation; the connection context contains no DB
    executor.

func WriteError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error)

TYPES

type Problem struct {
	Type        string `json:"type"`
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Status      int    `json:"status"`
	Detail      string `json:"detail"`
	Instance    string `json:"instance"`
	TraceID     string `json:"traceId"`
	Code        string `json:"code"`
	OperationID string `json:"operationId,omitempty"`
	Outcome     string `json:"outcome,omitempty"`
}
    Problem exposes safe metadata without SQL, DSN, token or raw error text.
